_comment: Representative test queries for semantic image search on the demo AOI (Navi Mumbai: airport construction site, tidal creeks, mangroves, villages). 'expect' says what a relevant chip should show, judged visually. 'proxy' (water / vegetation) enables the automatic spectral-index agreement check in lumon/imagery/semantic_eval.py. Includes queries for things that are NOT in the AOI (negative controls): they still get ranked results, which is the point.

queries.expect: the Navi Mumbai airport runway or terminal (built 2021-2025)
mangrove or other dense green vegetation
NEGATIVE CONTROL: not present in the AOI
NEGATIVE CONTROL: no harbour in the AOI; ships are below 10 m resolution
